metadata.case_name: YAM LAI CHAU v. YAM HING KUEN T/A UNION AIR CONDITIONING ENGINEERING CO

source: The plaintiff claimed common law damages for injuries he suffered as a result of electrocution allegedly in the course of his removing the air conditioning compressor from the structures inside the air conditioning facility room on the 29th floor of a commercial building in Wan Chai (the “Location”).
He sustained electrical shock injury, and there were blisters to his left middle and ring fingers. He lost consciousness immediately.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple superficial injuries of wrist or hand

injuries.description: Burn injury to the pulp of the left middle and ring fingers
source: He sustained electrical shock injury, and there were blisters to his left middle and ring fingers.
The burn injury was with the pulp of the left middle and ring fingers.
The burnt left middle and ring fingers were treated conservatively with dressing and the wound eventually dried up.
By the time of discharge, there was residual stiffness of both fingers with weakened hand grip.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of finger or thumb

injuries.description: Generalised muscle injury / elevated muscle enzyme
source: It was generalized muscle damage only without damage to bone and nerves.

manifestations.description: Blisters to his left middle and ring fingers
Residual stiffness of both fingers with weakened hand grip
Painful and hypersensitive pulp over the two burnt fingers
Muscle pain and bone pain to the whole body

treatments_received.treatment: A&E attendance and admission as in-patient
source: He did not seek treatment until the next day. He attended A&E, and was then admitted to in-patient care for hospitalization for 7 days.
The burnt left middle and ring fingers were treated conservatively with dressing and the wound eventually dried up.
He was later referred to out-patient physiotherapy and occupational therapy. He had out-patient physiotherapy from 2 December 2014 until 30 December 2014.

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy (4 sessions from 4 December 2014 until 19 December 2014)
source: He had 4 sessions of occupational therapy from 4 December 2014 until 19 December 2014.

losses.description: Residual stiffness of both fingers with weakened hand grip and hypersensitive, painful pulp of left middle and ring fingers following burn injury
